h1: The 7 Best Nightstands with Drawers for Small Bedrooms, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Nightstands with Drawers: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 nightstands with drawers compared on drawer type, charging ports, weight limits, height against the mattress and tip safety.
summary: The Yoobure 2-drawer nightstand is the one to buy for most bedrooms, with certified charging, a 100 lb capacity and a compact base. The Huuger 2-drawer is a close second with a USB-C port and an open shelf, the WLIVE is the cheap no-frills pick, and the SONGMICS BELLAH suits taller beds and anyone who wants extra ports and LED lighting.
intro: The usual mistake with a budget nightstand is measuring the floor and forgetting the mattress. A table that is 20 inches tall next to a bed with a tall mattress means reaching down for your glasses every night, while one that is too tall pokes your elbow. Height matters at least as much as the number of drawers, and it is the first spec to check.

So this ranking leads with fit and safety, then drawers and charging. We reviewed seven nightstands with drawers from their listings and dimensions, comparing height, drawer construction, power and USB ports, capacity ratings and anti-tip hardware. Where a spec is not listed we leave it out, and we dropped a four-drawer dresser because it is not a nightstand.

products.name: Yoobure Nightstand with 2 Drawers + Charging, Vintage Brown
products.verdict: Two fabric drawers, four charging outlets and FCC and ETL certification at a small price.
products.description:
The Yoobure measures about 15.75 by 11.81 by 23.62 inches, with engineered wood and a steel frame. It has two fabric drawers, two USB ports, two AC outlets and a stated 100 lb capacity, and it carries FCC and ETL certification.

It wins because the charging is certified, which matters for an item that plugs into the wall beside a bed. ETL and FCC marks are the paperwork that separates a real power strip from a cheap knockoff. The 23.62 inch height suits most standard mattresses, and the small footprint fits a narrow bedroom. Compared with the Huuger, you get two AC plus two USB rather than USB-A and USB-C.

Buy it if you want tidy storage and safe charging in a small space. The caveat is that fabric drawers do not hold heavy items.
pros: Two AC outlets and two USB
products.idealFor: Small bedrooms that need safe charging beside the bed.
products.skipIf: You need heavy-duty drawers for tools or books.

products.name: Huuger Nightstand with 2 Drawers + Charging, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: Two drawers, an open shelf, two AC outlets and both USB-A and USB-C ports.
products.description:
This Huuger nightstand is 15.7 inches wide, 11.8 deep and 23.6 tall, with P2 particleboard and a powder-coated steel frame. It has two fabric drawers, an open shelf, two AC outlets, one USB-A port and one USB-C port, and the finish is stain resistant.

It ranks second because the USB-C port is the thing a newer phone or tablet charges from, and the Yoobure lacks it. The open shelf is useful for a lamp base or books you reach for daily. It sits behind the Yoobure because the listing does not mention FCC or ETL certification, and a stated weight capacity is not given either.

Buy it if you charge modern devices and like an open shelf. Skip it if certified electrical marks matter to you.
products.idealFor: People charging a phone and tablet with USB-C.
products.skipIf: You want certified wiring stated on the listing.

products.name: WLIVE Night Stand with 2 Drawers, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: A simple two-drawer nightstand, with a 100 lb capacity and certification, minus the charging.
products.description:
The WLIVE measures 15.7 by 11.8 by 20.9 inches, with an MDF body and steel frame. It has two fabric drawers and a water-resistant wooden top, with a stated 100 lb capacity and FCC and ETL certification.

It ranks third because the lower 20.9 inch height suits a low bed or platform frame, and it keeps the price down by skipping outlets. There is nothing to wire or fail, which some buyers prefer. Against the Yoobure, you lose charging and about three inches of height.

Buy it if you have a low bed and charge elsewhere. Skip it if you want ports on the table.
products.idealFor: Low bed frames and simple setups.
products.skipIf: You want charging at the bedside.

products.name: SONGMICS BELLAH Nightstand with 3 Drawers + App LED, White
products.verdict: Three drawers, five charging ports, app-controlled LED lighting and an anti-tip kit.
products.description:
The BELLAH measures 15.6 by 11.8 by 29.9 inches, combining particleboard, steel and PVC leather. It has three drawers, five ports in total (two AC, two USB-A and one USB-C), app-controlled music-sync LED lighting, an anti-tip kit and a 66 lb capacity.

It ranks fourth because the extras are real, but they come with tradeoffs. The 29.9 inch height suits a tall bed and gives a third drawer, but sits too high for a low frame. The LED lighting is a matter of taste, and any app-controlled feature adds one more thing to set up.

Buy it if you have a tall bed and want ports and storage in one. Skip it if you want simplicity.
products.idealFor: Taller beds that need maximum storage and ports.
products.skipIf: You prefer a simple bedside table.

products.name: Huuger Nightstand with 3 Drawers, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: The tallest Huuger, with three drawers and the same charging array.
products.description:
Standing 27.6 inches tall on a 15.7 by 11.8 inch base, this Huuger is built from P2 particleboard and powder-coated steel. It has three fabric drawers, two AC outlets, one USB-A port and one USB-C port, with a stain-resistant finish.

It ranks fifth because it offers more drawers than the two-drawer Huuger, but at 27.6 inches it only suits taller bed heights, and the listing gives no capacity or certification. The third drawer helps with storage, though fabric drawers stay light-duty.

Buy it if you need more drawers and your mattress is high. Skip it if your bed is low.
products.idealFor: High beds needing extra drawers and charging.
products.skipIf: Your bed sits low to the floor.

products.name: SUPERJARE Nightstand with Adjustable Drawer, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: One adjustable fabric drawer with two positions above three open shelf tiers.
products.description:
The SUPERJARE measures 15.7 by 11.8 by 23.4 inches, with P2 particleboard and metal. It has a single fabric drawer with two position settings, three tiers of open shelves, a USB-C port and a stain-resistant finish.

It ranks sixth because one drawer is the least storage in the group, though the adjustable position lets you change the open space around it. The open tiers suit books and baskets. It lacks AC outlets, so it is a phone charger rather than a power strip.

Buy it if you want to display items and need one drawer. Skip it if you want multiple closed compartments.
products.idealFor: People who want a mix of display and drawer.

products.name: Furologee End Table with 2 Drawers + Charging, White
products.verdict: A slim white end table with two drawers, charging and S-hooks, rated for 50 lb.
products.description:
The Furologee measures 11.75 inches wide, 14.96 deep and 22.25 tall, using engineered wood and metal. It has two fabric drawers, two tiers of open shelves, two outlets, two USB ports, two S-hooks and a 50 lb capacity.

It ranks seventh because the 50 lb rating is half that of the Yoobure and the WLIVE. The narrow width, though, makes it easy to tuck into a tight gap beside a bed. The S-hooks are a small touch for hanging a bag or headphones.

Buy it if space beside the bed is very narrow. Skip it if you place heavy lamps or books on top.
pros: Two outlets and two USB ports
products.skipIf: You need to hold heavy items.

methodology.description: We checked outlets, USB-A and USB-C ports and FCC and ETL marks where listed.

whatMatters.detail: A good nightstand top sits within a few inches of the mattress top, so reaching is easy. Measure from the floor to the top of your mattress and compare it with the listing height. Taller tables like the BELLAH suit high beds, while a 20.9 inch table suits a low frame.

Fabric drawers are light, cheap and easy to ship, but they hold shape poorly with heavy items. Rigid drawers handle weight better. Check the listing for drawer material and expect fabric bins to suit clothes, chargers and remotes.

A built-in outlet strip adds convenience but also an electrical risk if poorly made. Look for FCC and ETL marks, which show the wiring has been checked. Count AC outlets, USB-A and USB-C ports against the devices you charge.
A stated capacity of 100 lb is plenty for a lamp, clock and books. A 50 lb rating needs more care. Look for the number on the listing and spread loads evenly.
Taller, narrow tables can topple, especially with children or pets. An anti-tip kit anchors the table to the wall. Check whether one is included and use it.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A footprint near 15 inches or less, a height that matches your mattress, and drawers that close tidy clutter. Wall-anchor hardware is a bonus.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: Yoobure for most, Furologee for the narrowest gap, and WLIVE for a low bed.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want a stronger frame, solid-wood drawers or a higher weight rating than these tables offer. Look above this price tier.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: The table holds a lamp and a phone. The Yoobure or WLIVE is plenty.

faq.q: Can these nightstands support a lamp and a clock?
faq.a: Yes. Tables with a stated 100 lb capacity, like the Yoobure and WLIVE, handle a lamp, clock and books easily. The Furologee is rated for 50 lb, so keep the top light.

faq.q: What mistake do buyers make with nightstands?
faq.a: Ignoring height. A table well below the mattress forces you to reach down, while one far above it blocks the bed. Measure your mattress before buying.

faq.q: Is a nightstand with charging worth it?
faq.a: For most people, yes, since it removes a power strip and cable tangle. Choose a model with FCC and ETL marks if you can, as with the Yoobure. Skip it if you prefer to avoid built-in wiring.
Most are flat-pack with screws and take under an hour. Charging models need the outlet strip plugged in last. Read the instructions before tightening everything.

faq.q: How do I clean fabric drawers?
faq.a: Remove the drawer bin if possible, then spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Let it air dry. Avoid soaking the cardboard-like base.

faq.q: Do I need to anchor a nightstand to the wall?
faq.a: Taller models like the SONGMICS BELLAH include an anti-tip kit, and you should use it, especially with kids or pets. Shorter tables are lower risk but anchoring is still safer.

finalTake: The Yoobure Nightstand with 2 Drawers and Charging is the one to buy for most bedrooms, thanks to certified charging and a sensible height. Choose the Huuger if you want USB-C and an open shelf, the WLIVE for a low bed and a plain table, and the SONGMICS BELLAH for a tall bed and all the extras.
